id: title:charlesvien:add gpt 6 sol and luna to the gateway and desktop

review.posthog_relevance: Updates the Codex adapter's model capability and pricing configuration, establishing tiered selection and billing parameters for gpt-6 family models.
review.reason: The change replaces gpt-5.6 variants with gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-luna entries in capability and pricing configuration. P1.F15.H1 establishes the reasoning effort and model identity, while P1.F3.H2 defines token pricing. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for the Codex adapter, allowing the system to support and bill for the new gpt-6 family. No tier 3 claims
